collection.description: A child asks why different peoples exist, and the adults offer several competing explanations.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) asks why different peoples exist, and the adults offer several competing explanations.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (scholar), a scholar, explains that human populations have shared ancestry and histories of movement and adaptation.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) asks about a family story, and (scholar) distinguishes evidence from unanswered details.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Elders recount different traditions without claiming all are literal historical records.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Two villagers discover similar themes in stories that otherwise disagree.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The group affirms that appearance and ancestry do not determine worth or ability.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (villager) recognizes an unfair assumption they had made about a neighbor.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The question leads to a lively intergenerational discussion.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: No final answer satisfies everyone, but (child) learns that uncertainty is not failure.
